What it does

Loom is for the explanation that would take ten minutes to write and ninety seconds to say — walking a customer through what you found, or showing a team member a detail on site. Recordings come with automatic transcripts and summaries. Some customers still prefer a written summary, so it complements rather than replaces written communication.

Where the AI actually is

Automatic transcription, summaries and chapters for recordings.

Pros

  • Faster than writing for complex explanations
  • Builds trust with customers
  • Free tier covers short recordings

Cons

  • Customers sometimes prefer written summaries

Who it suits

Built with Remodelers & carpenters, Roofers, General contractors in mind. Explaining what you found on site without writing a long email.
